title: The Missing Portrait
author: Noor Quintana
blurb: Petra Whitlock, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
